name: Sena Miyuki
source:
Miyuki is a young girl freshly arrived in town. She came back for the same reason as [url=https://vndb.org/c69174]Yukito[/url], to find her big brother. She met [url=https://vndb.org/c69174]Yukito[/url] shortly after arriving in town in incredible circumstances.

She is a rather shy girl, especially with boys of her age, because she has only been to girls' schools. Having a nice face and a pleasing body, the boys often bother her and she is quite frightened of them and she sometimes calls them "[url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Man]Wolves[/url]".

Oddly, even though he often teases her, she is not frightened by [url=https://vndb.org/c69174]Yukito[/url], who has quickly become her friend she trusts.

She doesn't know how to lie, and seems messy given the state of her room ( or at all the messy stuff she probably hides in her closet when she receives [url=https://vndb.org/c69174]Yukito[/url] ). She always has good ideas, even if they seem a bit far-fetched.

[spoiler]In her route, she and [url=https://vndb.org/c69174]Yukito[/url] will participate in an event organized by the school, consisting of a three-legged race and a "runner's speech" at the end of the day. During the course, as they approach the finish line, Miyuki and [url=https://vndb.org/c69174]Yukito[/url] fall violently on the ground and roll their ankles. Not wanting to give up, [url=https://vndb.org/c69174]Yukito[/url] will then carry Miyuki to the finish line and arrive first. Some time later, it is their turn to go on stage and make their speech and it's Miyuki who speaks. Then she tells her story, her search for her brother, her arrival in the city, her meeting with [url=https://vndb.org/c69174]Yukito[/url]... Braving her shyness, she then turns to him and confesses her feelings and asks him to go out with her, that he agrees in front of the whole school.

Some time later, she learns who her [url=https://vndb.org/c69174]brother[/url] is, learns her true name, Miyuki ( 美幸 ) and learns she has [url=https://vndb.org/c14898]another sibling[/url].[/spoiler]
